prompts.text:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: high-resolution painted landscape background for a sprite-based historical strategy game's city panorama.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the selected original coastal city landscape.
Preserve the same wide 16:9 canvas, elevated isometric camera, composition, crop, terrain topography, grass texture, sunlight, color palette and all water/rocks/riverbanks/coastlines. This is an era variation of the SAME place, not a redesign. Keep the existing road centerlines, perspective, crossing locations and reserved open grassy areas for building sprites.
Change only the road corridors and the central paved meeting area into a clearly MEDIEVAL PAVED-ROAD version. Replace ALL bare dirt track segments with continuous fitted gray-buff cobblestone/stone-sett paving of modest period-appropriate width. Show individual uneven worn stones, restrained curb edging, softened grassy verges and subdued wheel wear. The central junction/plaza uses matching stone paving, smoothly joined to every approach. The route should read as a maintained medieval stone road end to end, not a mostly dirt path with scattered stones. No asphalt, lane markings, concrete barriers, modern sidewalks or modern objects.
Keep the established softly painted game-art finish with convincing material texture, not photographic roads pasted onto a painting. Large empty grassy building plots must remain. Full-bleed opaque landscape, no border or transparency, no buildings, people, vehicles, city sprites, text, labels or UI. Preserve water completely; roads must not run over the sea or river. High resolution and crisp native detail, matching the input's aspect ratio.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Create the MEDIEVAL paved-road variant of this coastal city-view landscape.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and authoritative NEW ROAD ALIGNMENT. Its carefully positioned narrow roads avoid fixed building plots. Image 2 is a MATERIAL/PALETTE reference for medieval worn cobblestone paving ONLY; do NOT copy image 2's obsolete diagonal roads or central junction.
Preserve image 1's exact canvas, framing, terrain, water, shoreline, rocks, grass, lighting, painterly style, road centerlines, gentle curves, branch positions, and route continuity. Change ONLY its asphalt/markings/road verges into medieval paved streets. Every road is continuous gray-buff irregular dressed-stone/cobblestone paving, individual worn stones, modest stone edging with soft grassy margins. Remove every painted lane marking, median, asphalt/concrete section, modern traffic feature. On the wider divided left approach replace both carriageways with ONE modest-width stone route centered within the old corridor, restoring grass along any freed shoulders. The already narrow local streets must NOT grow in width. Small branch turnarounds can become modest organic stone forecourts, not oversized plazas. No central X intersection, added roads, broad paved areas, new branches, buildings, vehicles, text, people, guides, colored overlays or UI. Water remains untouched.
